title: Ravens GM Eric DeCosta: "No indication" how long Rashod Bateman investigation will take

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens GM Eric DeCosta: "No indication" how long Rashod Bateman investigation will take
sources.description: Ravens wide receiver Rashod Bateman was arrested in June after allegedly breaking the windshield and windows of a car with his child and the child's mother inside, but he was not placed on paid leave by the NFL ahead of the cut to 53 players last weekend.
